notes.title: Eclipse Breaker Demo Update
notes.content: [p]We’ve been hard at work refining the demo to make sure it feels smoother, clearer, and more rewarding to play. This update focuses on quality-of-life improvements, balance adjustments, and key bug fixes, so every run feels tighter, fairer, and easier to read.[/p][h2][b]Highlights[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Sharper combat readability: reduced light spam, clearer targeting, and consistent red tells for unblockables/unparryables.[/p][/*][*][p][b]All attacks can now be dodged.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Ultimates are now infinite range.[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Rewards, UI, and progression tuned for smoother runs.[/p][/*][*][p]Multiple quality-of-life fixes and polish passes.[/p][/*][/list][h2]Full Changelog[/h2][h3]Visuals & Readability[/h3][list][*][p]Updated [b]art and VFX[/b] across the demo.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced excess [b]VFX light spam[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Improved visuals for [b]targeted enemies[/b] and when enemies are [b]out of range[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Unblockable attacks[/b] now show a [b]red telegraph[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Unparryable attacks[/b] now show a [b]red telegraph with a white pattern[/b].[/p][/*][/list][h3]Abilities & Progression[/h3][list][*][p]Revised and tuned most of the game’s [b]abilities and progression systems[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]All attacks can now be dodged.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]All ultimate abilities now have infinite range.[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Increased rewards for [b]Parry Prima[/b] and most [b]Parry equipment[/b] by ~33%.[/p][/*][/list][h3]UI & Quality of Life[/h3][list][*][p]Added a [b]warning[/b] if you try to depart without assigning all augments.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Radiance stacks[/b] are now displayed under the health bar.[/p][/*][*][p]Added option to [b]abandon runs[/b].[/p][/*][/list][h3]Fixes[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed pressing [b]Escape[/b] on the [b]reset confirm screen[/b] in Settings causing a soft lock.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed occasions where [b]Radiance[/b] would apply to dead characters or linger after death.[/p][/*][/list][p]Thanks for checking out the demo and sharing your feedback, it’s been hugely helpful in shaping these updates. We’ll keep polishing and tuning so every run feels better than the last... and don't worry, there's definitely more to come![/p][p][/p][p]Thanks again![/p][p]- The Lunar Workshop Team[/p]

notes.title: Yarrow Joins the Fight and the Constellation Grid is Complete
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We've got a big update for Eclipse Breaker's progress, featuring a powerful new spirit companion, some insights on our brutal endgame boss, and word on our completed constellation grid with new abilities to unlock.

[h1]New Spirit Companion: Yarrow, the Dieselpunk White Mage[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44906719/e067e5f6eb1023d2eb1924182796d1ce901668c4.png[/img]
When the Reclaimers of Light tried to save the world, she was the party's white mage. After Ember froze, she gave up, and the magic left the world, went out into the desert, and became a dieselpunk mage. She decided that the only way to heal people now is to steal the life essence of your enemy and use it to heal your friend.
[list]
[*] Yarrow isn’t your typical healer. She siphons enemy life to restore your own!
[*] Her passive, Blood Bags, attaches to enemies and lets you heal by dealing damage to them.
[*] Her ultimate, Sand Vortex, damages enemies and pops all active Blood Bags at once.
[/list]
Pair her with the new legendary augment Yarrow’s Sorrow to extend vortex duration, reapply Blood Bags, and dish out massive burst damage when enemies fall.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44906719/9922c403afb10cff43d044b10781813b5a42cd0d.gif[/img]

[h1]New Endgame Boss: Solara[/h1]
Solara, the Sun God, has arrived... and she’s not here to play fair:[list]
[*] Every attack critically hits.
[*] Parrying no longer cancels her moves.
[*] Expect elemental hazards, traps, and spikes between you and victory.
[/list]This is your true test of skill. Good luck.

We've been working on her abilities and now have the first four. She will be more complicated than the previous bosses, because we want a satisfying final boss battle. In case you missed it, we created a process/timelapse video of the work getting one of her attacks working. Check it out:
[previewyoutube=kO4WXHfusKg;full][/previewyoutube]
[h1]Constellation Grid Fully Implemented[/h1]
We’ve added 12 new upgrades to the constellation system. Some favorites:
[list]
[*] Ascendant Ultimate: Meditating now charges your ultimate.
[*] Double Action Trigger: Deal bonus damage for attacking the same enemy multiple times.
[*] Treacherous Strike: Deal up to 3x more backstab damage at low health.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44906719/75b0417a0934dd94899e92f88773cac1f3f2b714.png[/img]
The full constellation grid is now in place to customize your build and explore new strategies.

Thank you for the incredible support, feedback, and streams. If you’ve enjoyed the demo, please consider leaving a Steam review or telling a friend. It helps a ton!

And if you’re a content creator, don’t hesitate to tag us. We love highlighting community videos!

— The Lunar Workshop Team

notes.title: New Features, Bug Fixes and Visual Improvements Now Live in Newest Demo!
notes.content:
Hi all,

This update addresses several key issues reported by our players, aiming to enhance gameplay experience, improve UI usability, and ensure smoother overall performance for the demo.
 
We appreciate your valuable feedback, and if you’re enjoying the demo, please tell a friend!

[h1]Patch Notes for May 7th, 2025:[/h1]

[h2]Gameplay & Balance[/h2]
[list]
[*] Hitting an Armor Regulus twice will now break its shield.
[*] Defeating a boss now restores 30% of your max health.
[*] Attacking a Lancer while it’s airborne now correctly displays a "Miss!" message.
[*] Spike traps no longer damage players during their own turn action.
[*] Icebound Step’s ice zone duration has been increased.
[*] Ice traps now deal damage when they tick.
[*] Increased the duration and splash damage of Ice to encourage more player use.
[*] Radiance no longer applies to dead or unhittable enemies.
[*] Holding the Meditate button will now resume meditation automatically after an ability ends.
[/list]
[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where pressing Escape during the confirm quit menu caused UI inconsistencies.
[*] Fixed a bug where new Prima effects like Fire and Ice could trigger during a player’s turn.
[*] Fixed an issue where players could get stuck in Amanzi after certain attacks.
[/list]
[h2]UI & Visual Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added a custom mouse pointer to improve mouse visibility when using keyboard and mouse.
[*] Improved enemy selection and the highlight for the currently targeted enemy.
[*] Improved visual feedback for when to press the Trigger key.
[*] Reduced “flashbang” intensity at the end of levels when flashy effects are active.
[*] Added spacing around the word "Constellation" in the temple UI.
[*] Spike traps have updated visuals, including effects that show when they’re about to trigger and when they reset.
[*] Introduced a 0.5 second delay before reward selection to reduce accidental clicks.
[/list]
[h2]Tutorials & Onboarding[/h2]
[list]
[*] Enhanced the opening narrative sequence based on player input.
[*] Added checklists and tutorials to better explain the Spirit Companion and Augments systems.
[/list]
[h2]Performance & Accessibility[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added a framerate limiter (on by default) to reduce system resource usage.
[/list]

notes.title: The New Eclipse Breaker Demo Is Here!
notes.content:
Hey everyone, Jorge here, developer of [i]Eclipse Breaker[/i]!

We’ve just launched a major update to our playable demo, and I couldn’t be more excited to share it with you. This new build brings a ton of improvements, new content, and polish, all designed to push the game closer to our vision. Want to see it in action? Check out our revamped trailer:

[previewyoutube=QsXG7U_JMjE;full][/previewyoutube]

Whether you’ve played before or just heard about Eclipse Breaker, now is the perfect time to dive in.

[h1]What’s New in the Demo:[/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]New Bosses[/b]
Face off against brand-new, challenging enemies designed to test your builds and tactical choices.
[*] [b]Revamped UI Art[/b]
We’ve completely overhauled the interface to make it more intuitive, readable, and stylish.
[*] [b]Deadly Traps[/b]
Watch your step! Environmental hazards now force quick decisions and sharper planning.
[*] [b]Spirit Companions[/b]
Discover unique allies who bring new powers and strategic depth to each run.
[*] [b]Expanded Dialogue[/b]
Dive deeper into the world of Eclipse Breaker with new character interactions and story content.
[*] [b]Fresh Enemies[/b]
A variety of new threats await, each with distinct behaviors that challenge your approach.
[/list]
[h1]We Want Your Feedback[/h1]
This update represents a huge step forward, but Eclipse Breaker is still evolving and your input is vital! We’d love to know what you think about the new content, combat balance, pacing, or anything else that stands out.

You can leave feedback right here in the comments, post in the community forums, or [url=https://discord.com/invite/X5ensHc4UC]join us on Discord[/url] to chat directly.

Thanks again for all the support, and we hope you enjoy the new build!
— Jorge

notes.title: Get Early Access to the New Eclipse Breaker Demo – Private Playtest Now Live!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We’re thrilled to announce that the all-new [b]Eclipse Breaker demo[/b] is just around the corner, and we want you to help shape it before release. This update completely refreshes the experience compared to our current public demo—and we can’t wait for you to see what we’ve been working on.

[h1]What’s New?
[/h1][list]
[*] [b]New Bosses[/b]: Face off against challenging foes that put your strategic skills to the test.
[*] [b]Revamped UI Art[/b]: Enjoy a sleeker, more intuitive interface that keeps the action flowing.
[*] [b]Deadly Traps[/b]: Watch your step! We’ve added brand-new traps to keep you on your toes.
[*] [b]Spirit Companions[/b]: Discover unique allies that add depth and synergy to your roguelike runs.
[*] [b]Expanded Dialogue[/b]: Dive deeper into the game’s narrative with new character interactions.
[*] [b]Fresh Enemies[/b]: Test your combat prowess against an array of fearsome new adversaries.
[/list]
All these changes and more have made Eclipse Breaker feel like a totally different game, and we’re so excited to share it with you. However, [b]we need your help[/b] to polish the experience even further.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44906719/0fb5d3307f9fda4667a82eacaff1a950be2ab7c7.gif[/img]
[h2]Join Our Private Playtest[/h2]
Starting now, you can [b]jump into the demo playtest[/b], giving you early access to the development build of the upcoming demo well before anyone else. Your feedback has been crucial to us, inspiring countless improvements over time. Now’s your chance to have an even bigger impact on how Eclipse Breaker evolves. The playtest will run until [u][b]March 28th at 10AM Pacific Time[/b][/u].

[h2]Why Join?[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Play First[/b]: Experience new features and content ahead of the official demo launch.
[*] [b]Shape the Game[/b]: We rely on your insights to refine difficulty balance, uncover bugs, and fine-tune the gameplay loop.
[*] [b]Direct Dev Access[/b]: We’ll be checking feedback regularly and discussing changes with the community.
[/list]Our community’s suggestions have already guided hundreds of improvements, and we want to keep that momentum going.  To that end, [b]every playtest player that shares feedback will receive a credit inside the game[/b]. Be sure to use the Feedback form tagged in-game to do so. We appreciate your enthusiasm and can’t thank you enough for helping us bring Eclipse Breaker to life.

[h2]Ready to Play?[/h2]
Head over to our Steam page and play now! 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2815060/Eclipse_Breaker/

Stay tuned for more news, and thanks again for your continued support. We look forward to hearing your feedback and seeing you on the battlefield in Eclipse Breaker!

—
[b]The Eclipse Breaker Team[/b]

notes.title: "I accidentally played all night" - See what's new in Eclipse Breaker
notes.content:
We're back from the holiday! I hope you had a great holiday season and a happy new year. If you got some runs in on our public demo that we launched recently, then you may have been one of the people who said this about it:

[list]
[*] "Yea I just clocked in another 79 minutes on the main game"
[*] "I accidentally played it all night ... Eclipse Breaker is awesome"
[*] "This game is incredible. Such a unique experience, what you're doing with it is awesome"
[/list]

Thank you to everyone who played and sent us kind words. The demo is still up. To play, just head over to the Steam store page and click "Download".

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2815060/Eclipse_Breaker/]Play the demo now![/url]

Let's talk about new features. First, the feature I'm most excited to share is the new companion, [b]Logren[/b]. He's a mercenary who lends his spirit axe to Ember along with a new passive, [b]Overkill[/b]. When Ember damages enemies that are already dead her abilities become empowered, dealing extra damage on their next attack. Logren also grants Ember a new ultimate ability, where ember spins his axe around her and then slams it down on an enemy's head for massive damage.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44906719/0f3a21e6110628eac7d0e612353cf99a7d99df93.gif[/img]

Next, lately we've been working on a story for the game. In my post last month, you've already met [b]Ember[/b] the game's protagonist, and [b]Sylphie[/b], the keeper of the Temple of the Gate. This month I'm happy to introduce [b]Solara[/b], the Sun God. It is her theft of the sun that prompted Ember's quest. She's the game's end boss, and now she has a portrait and a part to play in the game's story as well. Why did she take the sun? You'll just have to play the game to find out. Props again to the illustrator, Devin Yang.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44906719/a01f5b592ef616b84102cfc96eb6e2896d3bae56.gif[/img]

And finally, I'm also excited to share this new enemy. The [b]Lancer[/b] jumps in the air and stays up there for some period of time before slamming down in an unblockable, unparryable attack. You must press the dodge button to avoid taking damage for this one. While he's up in the air he is also immune to damage and can't be targeted. When he's out of sight, he's out of mind, so he may surprise you while you're focused on other enemies.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44906719/6b908a59c35712f22f8731ad3d53cbbad49d2217.png[/img]

None of those three features are in the public demo, but they're available right now in the private build if you have been given a key. If you're reading this post and you're interested in playing, especially if you're willing to give me feedback on the new narrative, send me an email to jorge@lunarworkshop.com and ask for a key. I have a few extra keys that I can give out at the moment and I would sincerely appreciate your thoughts and feedback on the narrative we've implemented so far. I want to make sure it's something you enjoy and want to see more of.

notes.title: What Happens To Your Feedback? Introducing Earth & Water Primas + Companions!
notes.content:
Hello! I've got a ton of updates I have been itching to share, but first I wanted to say [u][b]thank you[/b][/u] to everyone who participated in the September 30 playtest. A lot of people played and we got a ton of great feedback. Addressing that feedback has been my top priority, and in addition to a ton of small improvements motivated by your feedback I have also been adding some big new features. I'm very grateful to everyone who played the game and sent me feedback.

So let's talk about what's new in Eclipse Breaker this month. First, because we introduced two new Primas, here's a primer and Primas: Primas are passive abilities that you can attach to your attacks as you progress through a run. They're kinda similar to the materia from Final Fantasy VII.

[h1]Earth Prima[/h1]

The new [b]Earth Prima[/b] creates a rupture on the ground around enemies that deals periodic damage to all enemies inside it. Any enemy standing in this rupture receives periodic damage. If enemies stand in the spot where two ruptures overlap they receive not just 2x damage but 3x damage, and if enemies stand where three ruptures overlap they receive not 3x damage but 6x damage. So the key to using these ruptures is to overlap them on clusters of enemies. Check this out:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44906719/2a4a7a5da12faac746b7c6fe9be4a0fa4d80c043.gif[/img]

I also added the [b]Water Prima[/b], which drenches enemies and creates waves that hit nearby enemies and damage them as well. Enemies that are drenched reflect waves back out at other enemies, and make them again more drenched. These waves can reflect off enemies infinitely if they are drenched enough. So this is another good prima to use against close clusters of enemies.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44906719/6efdcafc574d1e7f5c2c38fb1c4bf60c4935356c.gif[/img]

[b]Companions[/b] are allies that you can take with you on your journey. Taking a new companion changes your passive and ultimate abilities and allows you to unlock modifications for your other abilities. Awards that you obtain during your run will allow you to upgrade your companion's abilities. So far I've only built one of the companions, but now that the system is built the remainder should be easier to slot in, so be on the lookout for more companions in future builds.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44906719/b516f163c70b1abbf76fdb7cf2a1bd76a2866ac5.png[/img]

And finally, I have received a lot of player feedback that there's now much to do while the player's stamina is recharging. Well you spoke and I listened and added [b]Meditation[/b]. Now the player can press a button to regenerate their stamina faster. Some companions are planned to augment the player's Meditation as well. For example, it is subject to change, but some companions may allow your Meditation to also grant your next attack more damage.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44906719/15b9fc24ca79a18e6bb84d6bf73a8526824c183b.gif[/img]

notes.title: ❄️ Frozen Foes: Meet Friga, the New Ice Queen ❄️
notes.content:
Meet Friga the Ice Queen. You'll encounter her as a miniboss as you play. I'd love to show you how she works, but before we get to that, I need to explain how I've reworked the Ice prima.

[h1]Ice Prima Reworked[/h1]

Primas are passive abilities that you can attach to your attacks as you progress through a run. They're kinda similar to the materia from [i]Final Fantasy VII[/i]. The Ice prima increases how much damage your attacks deal and applies the [i]Frozen[/i] effect, which applies a slow to enemies. However, I kept getting feedback from players that they didn't understand [i]Frozen[/i]'s effect and it wasn't very exciting, so I added some functionality to it. Check this out:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44906719/ef1a91e3ff25cda109ab33e6f3b3d84e82f81132.gif[/img]

Now whenever you attack a [i]Frozen[/i] enemy, it shatters the ice and sprays a shower of ice behind them, damaging and applying [i]Frozen[/i] to all enemies behind. This effect can chain and occur multiple times from a single application, which makes it great against crowds of enemies.

With that in our pocket let's check out Friga's attacks!

[h1]Ice Shards[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44906719/253ae19f70a6fa2283c2b26e1c3972670014d929.gif[/img]

Her first basic attack throws three ice shards at the player. If you are feeling bold you can parry all three of these individually and gain three stacks of [i]Radiance[/i] for a lot of extra damage. Otherwise you can simply block them normally.

[h1]Summon Pillars[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44906719/0fb5d3307f9fda4667a82eacaff1a950be2ab7c7.gif[/img]

She can also summon four frozen pillars. Stand near these pillars and you will be [i]Frozen[/i], meaning your movement speed will be slower and your stamina will recharge slower.

[h1]Frozen Slash[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44906719/99f25fc08e5008e36c347c6d5ad5e5067f93b37c.gif[/img]

Friga swipes her sword twice, dealing damage to you each time. But remember how I reworked the Ice prima to spray ice behind enemies? Well, Friga can do the same to you if you stand behind her ice pillars. Watch where you walk!

[h1]Clone Charge[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44906719/fad79d0819049b05e8446a64c343c6ceb025e410.gif[/img]

This was the most complicated for me to build, but also the coolest of all enemy abilities in the game so far. Friga splits in three and then each of the three clones charges at you, dealing damage if she touches you. The player must dodge all three charges to avoid damage.

[h1]Join the Mailing List[/h1]

By the way, [url=https://landing.lunarworkshop.com/eclipsebreaker]have you signed up for our mailing list[/url] yet? That's the best way to stay up to date on breaking news about Eclipse Breaker and other Lunar Workshop games, and [b]secure your spot in the upcoming preview build event[/b] that we're going to be releasing at the end of September!

notes.title: 🔥 Face the Heat: Eclipse Breaker's Vatra Boss Fight is Here! 🔥
notes.content:
I just released a demo to the update that adds the game's first boss, [b]Vatra the Fire Elemental[/b]! This will be the final demo update for a while, since I now have to put my nose to the grindstone to add a number of big new features.

In the meantime, since there aren't a lot of games similar to this in their combat systems I wanted to share some of the enemy designs with you. Here's a rundown on some of the enemies you'll encounter in Eclipse Breaker.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44906719/77deb59f270a23ee0849d36bf8d09ec51672f93d.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44906719/da2a8c4638cc5edd56fc879360d2d8bc8d84ac38.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Azothic[/h2]

First up is the Azothic. This fallen angel is basically the tutorial enemy. He dashes towards you and then charges up and unleashes a slashing attack. You can block, dodge, or even simply run away from this attack.

The player has a lot of options here because I'm allowing them to learn the controls and combat system in a forgiving environment. However, this enemy gets stronger and more formidable in groups and combined with other enemies, and you won't get maximum damage against them unless you learn his tricky parry timing.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44906719/a2b61004cef9db3885223980827f5b57415a31a0.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44906719/b39db6f3a8fd102be29877a60202a8ec9e9b436f.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Desiccant[/h2]

The Desiccant, with her demonic arm, fires an un-dodgeable attack that must be blocked or parried. She likes to keep her distance, but you can also avoid her attack by running out of her max range.

The Desiccant also comes in a "Stable" variety, who fires constantly in a fixed direction, occasionally re-aiming at the player. You'll find Stable Desiccants mixed into other combat encounters as an added layer of difficulty. Their attacks are more frequent and can be blocked and parried as usual, but you can dodge them or run away.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44906719/5903a1f6acbfa100a6c93b95d55ca1cf89c92806.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44906719/de6c1d522cb3752c6c4e79ad557424ead2b0eed9.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Athanor[/h2]

The Athanor leans his spiked wing and horns into you and charges at you for his attack. As the compliment to the Desiccant, you must either dodge or parry this attack - you cannot block it. (If you're quick you can avoid him by running laterally, but it's risky!)

This enemy comes later on and the timings are tighter. Make no mistake, this is the toughest enemy you'll face thus far. Many players end their first run when they see this enemy for the first time.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44906719/95632db5fa1e55474ee0eca3bac71a54edfef50e.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44906719/6973381d7c42be66570e1a62d639268bc1fbac5a.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Vatra[/h2]

Finally, I'm excited to announce Vatra, the game's first boss. He is the first enemy to have four different attacks. His two primary attacks are a double slash and a charge that leaves behind a fire trail. He can also throw a fireball at you that you must dodge away from, and summon multiple fire traps that you must avoid.

Narratively, he is unlike the common enemies in that he's not a fallen angel. Rather, he's an elemental demon. Defeating him grants the player a buff that allows them to attach elements to their abilities. I may write more about this in a future email.

[b]Fun fact[/b]: While all common enemies in the game are named after alchemical concepts, this boss instead takes his name from the Croatian word for "fire"!

[h2]Join the Mailing List[/h2]

By the way, [url=https://landing.lunarworkshop.com/eclipsebreaker]have you signed up for our mailing list[/url] yet? That's the best way to stay up to date on breaking news about Eclipse Breaker and other Lunar Workshop games, and [b]secure your spot in the upcoming preview build event[/b] that we're going to be releasing at the end of September!

notes.title: Demo Update 6/3 - New NPC, Updated Art
notes.content:
Welcome to [b][i]Monday[/i][/b], a day for updates that are live now

[list]
[*] A new variation of the Desiccant has been introduced. The Stable Desiccant lives around the outside of the play space and constantly fires in. She's an easy kill but makes combat just a little more complicated.
[*] Enemies in combat encounters can now spawn with barriers and different levels. Enemies also no longer always spawn in the same five spots, they'll now be more spread out when subsequent waves spawn. All of the combat encounters have been reworked.
[*] There's a new animation for the main menu, check out the attached video.
[*] There's new background art for the Temple of the Gate.
[*] A few of Ember's swords got art updates, including her default sword. All of her swords are now in!
[*] Bugfix: Player sometimes did not avoid damage when dodging enemy attacks, which also caused other strange bugs like being 1hp when you're also dead.
[*] Bugfix: Fix ultimates charging too fast at higher levels
[*] Bugfix: Fix the Azothic damaging the player if he hits other enemies with his attack
[/list]

The game is now much harder on account of the new enemy encounters. I still have not beaten it! I'll be tuning difficulty a lot more as time goes by but I want to see how this plays for the time being. My main focus continues to be on integrating art and building new content. I'm re-evaluating which content I intend on building though and I haven't made any concrete decisions yet, so stay tuned. Upcoming features are:

[list]
[*] New character models for Ember and NPCs
[*] New content of some kind, to be determined (Prima? Miniboss? More new NPCs? Training grid unlocks? Other?)
[/list]

As usual I would be honored to hear your feedback, post it on this forum or [url=https://discord.gg/X5ensHc4UC]join our Discord server[/url].

notes.title: Demo update 5/27 - New NPC, reworked tutorial
notes.content:
New build up today, because [b][i]today is Monday[/i][/b] and there's a new build every Monday. I promised a new NPC and he is here!

[list]
[*] The biggest new feature is this guy, a new NPC named the Azothic. He dashes at you and slashes, then backflips back and away from you. He also does not wear a shirt.
[*] The game's encounters have all been reworked to include this guy and have a more interesting progression of 8 enemy encounters.
[*] Less interesting to you veteran players, the game also features an entirely new tutorial system. I've been putting a lot of work into it to make sure the game is understandable to new players.
[*] All but one of the weapon-themed Equipment rewards grant you a new sword model now. Working on the last one, soon!
[*] Of course, a ton of bug fixes. The biggest one is that only a few Prima rewards were showing up very often and Equipment rewards weren't showing up as often as intended. There should be much more variety in rewards now.
[/list]

I thought I'd already had the game's UX and FTUE in order but I've made huge strides on it this week so hopefully I'll be able to get back to making actual new content soon 🙂 Upcoming features are:

[list]
[*] [strike]A new NPC[/strike] (delivered!)
[*] Art upgrades
[*] More Prima
[*] A miniboss
[/list]

notes.title: New Demo Available
notes.content:
A new build of the demo and closed beta have been released! Since this is the first Steam news update, here are all of the latest features:

[list]
[*]The first encounter is now an Ice Prima. Ice slows enemies move speed and stamina regen.
[*]In addition to Ice and Fire you can now also earn Lightning Prima, which applies the Charge effect. Charging up enemies causes them to detonate for additional damage.
[*]There are a lot of new equipment items. Nine total!
[*]There are now eight total encounters in the game, increased from four.
[*]When you die and go back to the Temple of the Gate you can now use any Polvite you have collected to upgrade your character.
[*]A ton of bug fixes and smaller improvements, including many suggested or inspired by community feedback.
[*]A lot of new audio, music, art, and effects.
[/list]

I will be releasing a new version of the demo and closed beta (each will be the same thing for now) every Monday, but I will only ping this role about once a month.

Soon to come, in no particular order:

[list]
[*]A new NPC
[*]Art upgrades for a few characters
[*]More Prima types
[*]A miniboss
[/list]

and thank you for playing Eclipse Breaker! I would love to hear any feedback you have. You can post it here or chat about it on the [url=https://discord.gg/K8KHmtZv9X]Eclipse Breaker Discord server[/url].
